verdict.rationale: a-Shell is an on-device, open-source Unix-like terminal for iOS with no hosted service. Choosing a cloud storage region or data residency is a hosted-service axis that does not apply to this kind of local app. The pickFolder feature lets users pick local directories inside other apps' sandboxes, but that is a different control, not region or residency selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
